name: The Westin Carlsbad Resort & Spa
positioning: A hilltop coastal resort just north of San Diego, next to The Crossings at Carlsbad golf course, with a private entrance to LEGOLAND California for guests
best_for: Golfers wanting a course a short walk from their room
Travelers wanting ocean-view balcony rooms and a spa

facts.text: The resort is a coastal retreat just north of San Diego.
Most rooms have a private balcony.
Rooms feature the Westin Heavenly Bed and spa-inspired bathrooms.
Ocean Pearl Spa offers ocean-inspired services such as massages, facials, body treatments and nail services.
The Crossings at Carlsbad golf course is adjacent to the hotel.
The resort is less than a mile from The Flower Fields at Carlsbad Ranch.
The resort has an outdoor pool and a fitness center.
Verise is an Italian restaurant with handcrafted pastas and wood-fired cooking.
20Twenty is an American restaurant with a farm-to-table menu.
Dogs receive complimentary amenities including a Westin Heavenly Dog Bed and a welcome kit.
The wedding setting features sprawling lawns and ocean breezes.

highlights.text: Perched high on a hill, each premium room offers panoramic ocean views and a balcony.
Hotel guests enjoy a private entrance to LEGOLAND California.
The Crossings at Carlsbad offers Pacific coast views and is a five-minute walk from the rooms.
Ocean Pearl Spa offers ocean-inspired massages, facials and body treatments.

considerations.text: The hotel is not on the sand: Carlsbad Beach is a short drive away.
WhataHotel notes the large resort size may feel less intimate.
